Calculate Income Tax

Example

The 2025 to 2026 caseworker calculator. It does not submit a return.

Tax year 6 April 2025 to 5 April 2026

Work out the tax from the whole return

Every schedule from the caseworker workbook is here, and the figures are worked through the same stages as the workbook: income, allowances, tax, National Insurance, capital gains, student loans and the other charges.

Blank amounts count as zero, as they do on the workbook. Open a schedule to enter that part of the return. The total stays beside the form while you fill it in, and the stages underneath show the boxes the workbook calculated.

How this was worked out

The stages and the formulas are taken from the 2025 to 2026 caseworker workbook (2026.xlsm, version V1.5.1). Rates and allowances are the figures on its data sheet.

This page is an example of that workbook. It does not submit a return and it is not an HMRC service.
